## Description

Brief summary of changes and why they are necessary.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring / Code style (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI / Tooling improvement

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format (e.g. `feat: ...`, `fix: ...`)
- [ ] No AI attribution or "Co-Authored-By" tags in commit messages or code
- [ ] All unit tests pass locally (`python3 -m unittest discover tests` and `node --test tests/model-commands.test.mjs`)
- [ ] No sensitive credentials, auth tokens, personal data, or private keys included
- [ ] Code follows project conventions (modular, documented, clean)
